L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 53503c6a2688cf29bb9427f8264dec135e010429
Card: #34722 · claim 6943575066 · amendments 6943956723 and 6946649244 · os-dev reports 6943931103 (premise stop) and 6946593215 (final, this head)

All six card items are built on the Installed Apps door only, inside the amended surface. The badge and the version rule are imported from `console/marketplace/`, not copied. The locale-only widening (`Clause-②: yes (widening — locale keys only)`) is delegated to L1-a and holds. No must-fix. One should-fix (an ARIA reference). **The declared narrowing is the seat's:** the claim says "one reviewer read at contract-review tier is owed on the narrowing before the queue", and this L1 does not stand in for it. I have routed it to the seat.

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

1. **`aria-controls` names an element that does not exist.** The module toggle carries `aria-controls={\`pkg-modules-${rowId}\`}` (`PackagesPage.tsx:2142`), but no element has that id: the module rows are bare `<TableRow>`s keyed by their own ids. When the toggle is open, the reference dangles, and axe's `aria-valid-attr-value` reports it for `aria-expanded="true"`. One line fixes it, either way: give each module `<TableRow>` an id and list them, or drop `aria-controls` (`aria-expanded` already carries the state, as #34684's compact stage list does). It does not block landing.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34722`, with no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)` in the title. The narrowing is a UI door move inside the same component, not a contract narrowing, so no dogfood battery is owed. The contract-review read the claim names is separate (above). |
| Scope | 8 files, +913/−12. `PackagesPage.tsx`, the new `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx` and the edited `PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx` are in `views/metadata-admin/**`. The `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` edit is in `console/marketplace/**` (amendment 1 route). `studio/{en,zh}.ts` and `marketplace-handbook.mdx` are named by amendment 2. The changeset is in `.changeset/`. Nothing in `console/marketplace/` source is edited. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/**` is untouched. |
| Merge head | One main merge (`a175016b`, main `f02f4f63`), with later commits on top. GitHub reports `mergeable_state: clean`. |
| (1) Discriminator | `installedAppsView = sourceFilter.value === 'marketplace'` already existed and is what Setup's nav sends (`params: { source: 'marketplace' }`). Every new branch is gated on it: `actions` / `foldedActions` → `undefined`, the platform switch, the Source chip, and the new table. The Studio table (the `: (` arm) is outside the diff, so Studio's branch is unchanged. Another `?source=` keeps its Show-all chip, which is pinned in the edited 12675 test. |
| (2) Catalog read | `readUpdateTargets` asks `getMarketplacePackage(install.packageId)` once per app line (never per module), using `latest_version.version`, else `versions[0].version`, then `updateTarget(install.version, latest)` (the marketplace's own rule). A `404` gives no badge. Any other rejection, or `!isMarketplaceEnabled()`, gives `unavailable: true` and one note. While reading, or while the marketplace namespace loads, the cell holds a `Skeleton`. An empty cell appears only after a completed read with no target, so silence is never drawn as "up to date". A sequence ref drops stale answers, and the effect keys on primitives. The header summary is the one / many count (card item 3). Pinned, with ablations for each arm. |
| (3) Folding | `appOfModule` folds a row only when `manifest.type === 'module'`, it is not of a platform scope, and it directly declares exactly one same-Source `type: 'app'` row in `manifest.dependencies`. That is the server's `isDisableableAppModule` tie, read from what `GET /api/v1/packages` already serves (the manifest whole). With zero or two-plus parents a module stays a line of its own, so nothing is hidden. Search shows a group when the app or any module matches, and opens it when a module matched. HotCRM's four-module shape is pinned in unit tests. Live it was read on a one-module fixture; four modules live is declared NOT MEASURED. |
| (4) Columns | Name (with "N modules" under an app), Version, Status, Source, Update, then Actions when shown. ID and Scope are gone from this view. Module lines get no row actions and no Update cell: they update with their app. |
| Badge door (amendment 1) | `InstalledAppUpdateCell` calls `useMarketplaceNamespace()` and draws `UpdateAvailableBadge` only on `ready`. On a namespace failure it still draws "→ vX" and Upgrade. The boundary test gains a declared `HOOK_GATED_DOORS` entry (`UpdateAvailableBadge.tsx` ← `PackagesPage.tsx`). A door counts as gated only while every outside importer is declared and its AST imports and calls the hook. An undeclared importer puts it back in the resident-key walk. Ablating the hook call turns 2/6 red. The guard is extended, not bypassed. |
| Clause-② (locale keys only) | Nine `engine.packages.installedApps.*` keys in the lazy `studio` namespace, which has only `en.ts` and `zh.ts`. All nine are in both, and the placeholders match (`{count}`, `{name}`). No export: `PackageManifestRow.dependencies?` is an optional member of an app-shell module type, and `@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true`. The badge's own key stays in the lazy `marketplace` namespace. `check-eager-closure-budget`: `i18n-locale-en` is 60.2 KB of a 60.5 KB ceiling, unchanged. |
| Changeset | `@object-ui/app-shell` (private) and `@object-ui/i18n` `patch`, plus the declaration lines. Each bullet matches the diff, including "never drawn as 'up to date'", "The tie is the one the server's disable door already reads" and the developer-doors list with the Show-all chip. |
| Existing-test edits | `PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx`: the "Show all clears it" case is rewritten to the declared narrowing (no chip on `?source=marketplace`), and the guard moves to a new `?source=code` case that still clears. No guard is dropped. Two module-top imports pay the CEL helpers' first load outside a clocked window. |
| Tests | Real commands with output: 3 files / 46 tests (16 new, 24, 6), app-shell type-check, and 71/71 derived gates. Eight ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob. Live in Chromium on `examples/app-multi-package` with a stubbed catalog: A1 (badge, Upgrade lands on `/system/marketplace/pkg_multi_core`, summary), A2 (no badge), A3 (note, no badge), A4 (module hidden, then shown). |
| UI strings | All nine are in `en` and `zh`, the two languages the `studio` namespace carries. |
| Docs | `marketplace-handbook.mdx` "each package of a suite as its own row" (made false) is reworded to the folded line in both places. `references/ui/page.mdx` ("Setup → Packages filtered to Source = marketplace replaces it") stays true. No other page names this list's columns or doors. |
| Acceptance | 1: badge "→ v6.4.0" and a link to the app's marketplace page (pinned; live on the fixture). 2: up to date gives no badge (pinned). 3: catalog unreadable gives the list plus one note, never "up to date" (pinned). 4: one line, expandable to its modules (four pinned in unit tests; one live). |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34815`: NOT governed, 925 lines. Tier S on the register. The seat's contract-review read on the declared narrowing comes before the queue (claim). |
| CI on this head | 66 check-runs: 54 `success`, 12 `skipped`, none failed or pending. That includes Test UI 16/16 plus the aggregate, Test Core's planned shards plus the aggregate, Build Docs, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, every Type Check and Lint family, Check Changeset (both runs), PR-body guards (both runs), Spec property liveness, Check Documentation Links and Governed Surface Queue Guard. |

### Notes

1. **Out of scope, from the dev:** Studio's Packages table clips its Actions column at 1400px. That branch is untouched here, and it is the seat's to file.
2. **`updateCandidates` groups over all marketplace rows**, while the drawn groups also drop `system` / `cloud` scopes. A marketplace install of a platform scope is not a real shape, so the two agree in practice. Sharing one scoped list would remove the doubt.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44080618620](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44080618620) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44080618620/job/134030226974)** — 失败步骤: Boot example apps and exercise real user flows

  ```
  @objectstack/dogfood:test:  FAIL   isolated  test/activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts > [#21154] a query over activity text or the approval snapshot, by a reader withheld a field of its record > a
    ↳ 失败原因: (这条 FAIL 之后 12 行内没有可识别的原因行 —— 点进 job 看)
  @objectstack/dogfood:test:  FAIL   isolated  test/activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts > [#21154] a query over activity text or the approval snapshot, by a reader withheld a field of its record > a
    ↳ 失败原因: (这条 FAIL 之后 12 行内没有可识别的原因行 —— 点进 job 看)
  @objectstack/dogfood:test:  FAIL   isolated  test/activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts > [#21154] a query over activity text or the approval snapshot, by a reader withheld a field of its record > a
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/dogfood:test: AssertionError: {"object":"sys_activity","records":[],"total":0,"hasMore":false}: expected 200 to be 403 // Object.is equality
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `test/activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts` — 24h 内已弹出 **8 个 PR**（#34347、#34713、#34744、#34750、#34751、#34813、#34815、#34817），但它们同属 **1 条投机栈** ⇒ **1 次独立命中**。汇总 issue：#34829（已刷新）
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 27 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
